title: Hayati Pro Max 6000 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Hayati Pro Max 6000 Bundle offers a complete solution for vapers seeking long-lasting performance and simplicity. This exclusive package includes two complete Hayati Pro Max 6000 Prefilled Pod Kits plus an additional Extra Pod. With two devices at your disposal, you can enjoy extended vaping sessions without interruption, keep a backup charged and ready, or switch between different flavours on the fly. Each kit features a compact, user-friendly design driven by an integrated 600mAh rechargeable battery. The device utilises an innovative auto-refill system, pairing a prefilled 2ml pod with 10ml refill reservoir to provide a total of 12ml of 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid. This setup delivers approximately 6000 puffs per device, balancing the portability of a pod kit with the longevity of a much larger system. Inside, dual mesh coil technology ensures consistent vapour production and reliable flavour clarity from the first puff to the last. The draw-activated design removes the need for buttons or settings, making it an ideal choice for everyday convenience. Available Flavours: The Hayati Pro Max series offers an impressive range of 40 flavours to suit every taste. Options include rich berry blends like Blueberry Cherry Cranberry and Mr Blue, soda-inspired profiles such as Cola Lime and Pink Lemonade, and unique tropical fusions like Pipeline Punch and Summer Dream. How To Set Up Your Hayati Pro Max 6000 Device Step 1 Remove the device and e-liquid refill bottle from the packaging. Step 2 Remove the safety stickers and take the lid off the refill bottle (do not remove the rubber cover). Step 3 Remove the plug where the refill container meets the pod. Step 4 Insert the bottle upwards into the side of the device until it sits flush. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to fill the 2ml tank chamber. Step 6 Leave to stand for several minutes to allow the coil to saturate. Step 7 Inhale to vape. ✅ Ready to vape
